instructions.task: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Identify the specific issue the customer is raising, so the message can be routed to the right team.
guidance: Pick the option that matches the customer's main request or problem, not every topic mentioned in passing.
Distinguish what kind of money movement is involved: card payment, cash withdrawal at an ATM, top-up (adding money to the account), or a bank transfer.
Distinguish questions about fees or exchange rates from questions about whether something worked.

criteria.activate_card: How to activate a newly received card, or how long activation takes.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring or has expired; getting a replacement for expiry.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted: which shops, merchants or ATMs take the card.
criteria.card_arrival: An ordered card has not arrived yet / is late; tracking a card in the post.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery options, delivery to a given place or date.
criteria.card_linking: Adding or linking a card in the app, including re-adding a card that was found after being lost.
criteria.card_not_working: The card generally does not work any more, without a specific declined payment or ATM context.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, retained or ate the card.
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless / tap payments do not work.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment at a shop or online was declined or rejected.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The ATM refused a cash withdrawal or the card was declined when withdrawing cash.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable (single-use) virtual card, what such cards are.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits on disposable virtual cards: how many can be created or how many times one can be used.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or receive a (regular) virtual card, its cost, or why it has not appeared.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual or disposable card does not work or was rejected.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting a physical (plastic) card, including a customer who has no PIN yet, has not received it, cannot find it, or is setting it for the first time.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a new card: where/how to order, by which channel, fees for ordering.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional, second or spare card, including for a family member, and its cost.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card issued is Visa or Mastercard, or asking for one brand.
criteria.atm_support: Which cash machines work with the card, or at which machines a PIN change is possible.
criteria.change_pin: How or where to change an existing card PIN to a new one. Not a customer who has no PIN yet or cannot find it.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked or rejected after wrong attempts; unblocking it.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which card brands (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) or currencies can be used with the account, e.g. for adding money.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The customer's card is lost, missing or stolen, or they are reporting it.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or purchase, typically to a merchant or name the customer does not recognise, that they did not make.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make.
criteria.compromised_card: Signs that someone else has access to the card or account: it may be compromised, someone else used it, unexplained activity such as money appearing that the customer did not add, or a request to freeze it because of misuse.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone with the banking app was lost, stolen, misplaced or left somewhere; protecting the account or using the app without the phone.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot, reset or cannot use the app passcode to log in.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise or did not set up.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification of a card top-up: the verification code for a top-up and why top-ups need verifying.
criteria.request_refund: Asking for a refund from a merchant for a purchase (item not received, changed mind), refund process.
criteria.refund_not_showing_up: An expected refund has not appeared on the account or statement.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice or more (duplicate charge).
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM dispensed less cash than requested or the wrong amount.
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was cancelled, terminated, reversed, reverted or returned to the account, or a payment the customer made can no longer be found; what that means.
criteria.cancel_transaction: Wanting to cancel or reverse a purchase or transaction the customer made.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge, fee or small amount (for instance about one pound or dollar) on the statement or app that the customer questions as an amount, even if they say they bought nothing for that sum. Not a whole payment to a merchant the customer does not recognise.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Setting up automatic top-ups (auto top-up when balance is low).
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on how much or how often the customer can top up.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Topping up the account using a debit or credit card; how to top up by card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque, where to deposit cash.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined or did not work.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted, cancelled or returned after appearing.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending or has not completed yet.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay or Google Pay, including topping up with them.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A deposited cheque or cash has not shown up in the balance.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: An incoming bank transfer or top-up by transfer has not shown in the balance.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to add money to the account by transfer from another bank, how to deposit money.
criteria.receiving_money: How to get paid into the account: receiving money from other people or an employer, including having a salary paid in, or paid in a currency other than the account's main one. Not about fees for receiving.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive (domestic or international).
criteria.pending_transfer: An outgoing transfer is pending; why and how long.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer was sent but the recipient has not received it.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through, asking why.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot send money to a particular recipient / beneficiary is not allowed.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancelling an outgoing transfer, or a transfer sent to the wrong account that needs fixing.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending and has not completed.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal from an ATM still shows as pending.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee was charged for paying by card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fees for withdrawing cash at ATMs.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee for sending money by transfer or for receiving incoming money; whether transfers or receiving money cost anything.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up by card (including foreign or international cards).
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer (e.g. SEPA).
criteria.exchange_rate: How exchange rates are set, what the current exchange rate is.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or extra costs for currency exchange.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange between currencies in the app, getting foreign currency.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies the account supports for holding, exchanging or spending.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card purchase abroad or in foreign currency.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to cash withdrawn abroad.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity, which documents or ID are needed.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification or identity details are required.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification is failing or not working, or the customer lacks ID.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Proving or checking the source of funds / source of money.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account, children using the service.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available or usable in, including whether the bank offers its cards or accounts to people living outside its home country.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details such as name, address, phone number.
